verdict.rationale: Agora is a real-time communications platform, and a built-in assistant in its console or docs is a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks and external integrations. It offers Conversational AI primitives for building your own voice agents, plus a CLI, MCP server and Skills for connecting an external coding agent. Neither is a built-in assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
